items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: When you sit at the piano, or James sits at the piano, when you cats sit there and play some church stuff

ctx.x: Did you have the gift of – the memory of lyrics at that time?

Not necessarily, even though some lyrics come back to me sometimes, you know. When you sit at the piano, or James sits at the piano, when you cats sit there and play some church stuff, lyrics come back to me, ‘cause I know the lyrics to all those songs. I played for the junior choir, you know. I played for the junior choir and, let’s see – that lasted for a while. Probably until – let’s see when – until I went to intermediate school. Intermediate school was probably the sixth or seventh grade. Then I took up…
So clarinet, you played for how long?
